changelog:
v2.14.0 - Shape Illusion Wallpaper

- New optical illusion live wallpaper: tricks the eye into seeing the physical phone as a custom shape (Heart, Pentagon/Shield, Oval) while holding it.
- Uses the accelerometer: as the phone tilts, a 3D shadow moves inside the cutout to create depth, and the background shifts to create parallax against the bezel.
- Tools -> Shape Illusion to pick the shape and set the wallpaper.
- Glassmorphism control center UI coming next.
